finding: cmp_rsqrt is a WAIT on cb_rms_sum (produced by the reader mcast), not SFPU work on 32 tiles. Combine round-trip = ~56us of 76us (74%). Root receives 8 cores x 8 tiles x 4KB = 256KB per row-block, 1MB total => inbound-NoC-bandwidth-bound at the root (256KB/14.8us = 17 GB/s = single-core inbound wall). Prior refinement-5 ablation attributed only 26% to the combine and called the case MATH-bound; the per-stage zones contradict that.
roofline: NOT at a roofline: necessary cross-core payload is 8 cores x 256 row-sums x 4B = 8KB per group; 1MB is moved. 128x headroom on self-inflicted traffic.

note: Cumulative ablation (RMS_NORM_ABLATE=combine) corrected my first zone read. cmp_rsqrt conflates the mcast WAIT with real SFPU work; the ablated run (no cross-core traffic at all) still spends 29.0us in cmp_rsqrt on 32 fp32 tiles per core = 906 ns/tile. Whole-op ablated = 56_732 ns, so the combine is 19_400 ns (26%) of the critical path -- confirming Refinement 5s figure, not my 74%.
